question: Which of the following shortcut key is used to start a new line in the same cell in MSExcel 365?
solution: The correct answer is __**Alt + Enter**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • ** Alt + Enter** shortcut in Excel 365 to insert a new line** within a cell**. • This is especially useful when you're dealing with data that needs specific formatting or when you need to organize information clearly** within a single cell**.
